decision_status_reason: The proposed use of MIR ATR over an existing silica fiber cannot be approved, as silica fibers do not transmit in the MIR ATR range (2.5–25 μm) and no source supports long-distance MIR fiber links. However, NIR methods for water in petroleum are compatible with silica fibers and may be worth testing if MIR ATR is not feasible. Further clarification on spectral requirements, fiber length, and analyzer location is needed.
